tokenIntroTitle: Shigo da Notion ta token ɗin API
tokenIntroDesc: Ku ƙirƙira token a Notion sannan ku liƙa shi a ƙasa. Bayan haka, shafukan da kuka haɗa da shi za su iya ƙaura zuwa Leafen.

handoff.title: Ba da shi ga wakili
handoff.body: Wakilin ku yana karanta Notion kuma ya nuna muku shiri; da zarar kun amince da shi, Leafen zai matsar da shi.
handoff.copiedConnect: An kwafa. Ku liƙa shi cikin wakilin ku. Zai bayyana a nan da zarar wakilin ya haɗu.
handoff.copiedStart: An kwafa. Liƙa shi ga wakilinka. Yana yin haɗin Notion tare da kai sannan ya ci gaba daga nan.
handoff.start: Taimaka mini in matsar da Notion ɗina zuwa Leafen ɗina ({{origin}}), workspace_id {{id}}. A amsar ka ta farko ga wannan — wadda ke bayar da rahoton haɗin ka, idan ka fara haɗawa — gaya mini yadda motsin ke tafiya, cikin waɗannan kalmomi: “{{firstWords}}” Sannan, da kayan aikin Leafen, karanta jagorar ƙaura (leafen_notion_migration_guide), kira leafen_notion_migration_sources kuma bi su.
handoff.firstWords: Ga yadda matsar da Notion ɗinka ke gudana: haɗa Notion → Leafen ya karanta shi → zan yi maka tambaya ɗaya, tare da shawarwarina (inda zai je, mutanen da ba su da asusu a nan, abin da zai motsa) → Leafen ya motsa duka — abun ciki, tsare-tsare, samfuri da sharhi — sannan ya duba shi da Notion → zan bayar da rahoto sau ɗaya. Duk abin yana faruwa a cikin wannan tattaunawa. Wasu daga yadda abubuwa suke kama ba su cikin abin da Notion ke ba wasu shirye-shirye (faɗin cikakke, shimfidar shafi, ginshiƙan allo, layukan da aka jera da hannu da makamantansu): idan na iya ganin Notion ɗinka a browser, zan daidaita su; in ba haka ba, suna zuwa a matsayin na asalin Leafen a wannan lokacin kuma rahoton zai lissafa kowanne. Babu abin da ke motsawa kafin ka amince, kuma karanta Notion ba ya canza komai a can. Tsawon lokacin ya dogara da yawan abin da ke akwai: Leafen yana ƙididdige shi da zarar ya karanta tsarin, cikin ƴan mintuna, kuma zan gaya maka a lokacin. Ina buƙatarka sau biyu: don haɗin Notion, da kuma amsa waccan tambaya ɗaya. Tsakanin haka za ka iya yin wasu abubuwa — Leafen yana gaya maka a akwatin saƙonsa yayin da kowane mataki ya ƙare.
handoff.finish: Kammala shigo da Notion da na yi da kaina zuwa Leafen ɗina ({{origin}}), workspace_id {{id}}, migration_id {{migration}}. Karanta jagorar ƙaura (leafen_notion_migration_guide) daga sashe na 6, sannan sa Leafen ya karanta abin da formats_left_groups a cikin leafen_notion_migration_status ke cewa ya rage (ɗaya bayan ɗaya da list formats_left) daga Notion ɗina da leafen_notion_migration_formats.
handoff.sameConversation: Manna shi a cikin wannan tattaunawa ɗaya da ka haɗa wakilinka a ciki.
handoff.agentGoesOn: Wakilin ku zai ci gaba daga nan.
handoff.tokenStays: Ana ajiye token ɗin a Leafen kawai kuma ba ya zuwa ga wakilin ku.

notionSteps.title: A Notion
items: Buɗe app.notion.com/developers/connections (“Haɗin masu haɓakawa” a cikin kayan aikin masu haɓakawa na Notion) kuma shiga Notion idan ya nema.

Idan jerin yana da haɗin da aka yi wa Leafen a baya, buɗe shi maimakon ƙirƙirar sabo (wanda ba a sake amfani da shi ba, ana iya share shi a “Yankin haɗari” na shafinsa). In ba haka ba, danna “Sabon haɗi”, rubuta suna kamar Leafen a “Sunan haɗi”, bar “API token” a ƙarƙashin “Hanyar tabbatarwa”, zaɓi wurin aikin da za a matsar idan ya nema, sannan danna “Ƙirƙiri haɗi”. Ƙirƙirar haɗi yana nufin yarda da sharuɗɗan masu haɓakawa na Notion.
A shafin haɗin, buɗe “Damar samun abun ciki”, danna “Gyara damar shiga”, zaɓi shafukan farko da za a matsar sannan danna “Ajiye”. Shafukan da ke ƙarƙashinsu za su bi tare.

Komawa cikin “Daidaitawa”, yi alama a kan “Karanta abun ciki” da “Karanta tsokaci” a ƙarƙashin “Iyawa” (ba tare da “Karanta tsokaci” ba, babu wani tsokaci da zai zo). Leafen yana karantawa kawai, don haka “Sabunta abun ciki”, “Saka abun ciki” da “Saka tsokaci” za su iya kasancewa a kashe. A ƙarƙashin “Ikon mai amfani”, zaɓi “Karanta bayanin mai amfani har da adiresoshin imel” (domin mutanen Notion su dace da membobin Leafen ta imel kuma a iya gayyatar su). Sannan kwafi token ɗin (ntn_…) da maɓallin kwafi da ke gefen “API token”.
notionSteps.token: Sannan saka token ɗin a cikin filin “Token ɗin API na Notion” da ke ƙasa.

migration.canceledLead: Abin da ya yi har yanzu ba ya bayyana a wurin aiki. Idan kun sake shigo da shi, zai sake karanta Notion daga farko, kuma ba zai sake yin abin da ya riga ya motsa ba.
migration.canceledAgainLead: Abin da guje-gujen da suka gabata suka motsa yana nan a wurin aiki. Shafukan da sassan da wannan gudu ya riga ya daidaita da Notion suna nan kamar yadda ya canza su, kuma shafukan da yake yin ba sa bayyana. Idan kun sake shigo da shi, zai sake karanta Notion daga farko, kuma ba zai sake yin abin da ya riga ya motsa ba.

failure.provider: Notion ya ƙi ko bai amsa buƙata ba. Ku sake gwadawa nan da ɗan lokaci.
failure.tokenRejected: Notion ba ya ƙara karɓar token na haɗin. Ku sake kwafa token na integration (ko ku ƙirƙira sabo) ku haɗa shi, sannan ku sake gwadawa; abin da aka riga aka motsa yana nan.
failure.connection: Ba a iya amfani da haɗin Notion ba: an cire integration ɗin ko token ɗinsa ya canza. Ku sake haɗa shi, sannan ku sake gwadawa.
failure.scope: Notion bai bar haɗin ya karanta shafukan da kuka zaɓa ba. Ku sake raba su da integration ɗin, sannan ku sake gwadawa.
failure.file: Ba a iya kwafa wani fayil da aka ajiye a Notion ba. Ku sake gwadawa; idan ya ci gaba da kasawa, ku bar fayiloli ko ku motsa su da hannu.
failure.planChanged: Shirin ya canza yayin da ake gudanarwa. Ku duba shirin, sannan ku sake gudanar da shi.
failure.planBlocked: Ba a iya aiwatar da shirin yadda aka rubuta shi ba. Ku duba shi tare da wakilinku.
failure.people: Daidaita mutanen Notion da membobin ya tsaya. Ku sake gwadawa daga Saiti → Shigo da bayanai.
failure.create: Leafen ya kasa ƙirƙirar abin da aka shigo da shi. Ku sake gwadawa; abin da aka riga aka motsa yana nan.
failure.leafen: Leafen ya tsaya yayin shigo da bayanai. Sake gwadawa; abin da aka riga aka matsar yana nan.
failure.trashed: An matsar da shafi ko layin da yake canzawa zuwa kwandon shara yayin aikin.
failure.deleted: An share shafi ko layin da yake canzawa yayin aikin.

migration.agentWorking: Wakilin ku yana aiki da shi. Kuna iya rufe wannan taga.
migration.agentRunning: Leafen yana canja shi da kansa. Za ka iya rufe wannan taga da wakilinka. Akwatin saƙonka zai sanar da kai idan ya gama; sa’an nan ka gaya wa wakilinka “An gama,” kuma zai duba sakamakon ya ba da rahoto.
migration.agentDone: Faɗa wa wakilinka “An gama,” sannan ya duba sakamakon ya ba da rahoto.
migration.afterDone: Idan ana ci gaba da rubutu a Notion, An kammala › “Sake shigo da canje-canje” yana kawo sababbi ko abin da ya canza kawai. Idan an ƙaura komai, a mai da Notion karatu kawai ko a daina amfani da shi — abin da ake rubutawa a Leafen ba ya komawa Notion.
migration.agentPlanningLead: Wakilin ku yana nuna muku shirin a cikin tattaunawar ku, kuma Leafen yana matsar da shi da zarar kun amince.
migration.commentsStopped: Sharhi sun tsaya a hanya. Waɗanda aka matsar har zuwa lokacin suna nan; sauran suna cikin Notion.
